instruction: A candid outdoor photograph captures a full shot of an older couple walking through a grassy park. On the left, the older bearded man in a beige polo shirt and brown pants (R1) walks forward, holding a black yoga mat under his arm. On the right, the older woman in a white t-shirt and beige pants (R2) walks alongside him, smiling warmly with a lowered water bottle in her hand. They move side-by-side in natural daylight, surrounded by soft green grass and distant trees.
